about: VisionClaw's first held-out evaluation set for the words of the final answer: written on 2026-11-19 together with answers.json, before anything was run on either, in a blind person's casual words, with the same kinds of request in other words. Never write a rule from its misses: it measures what was written from answers.json. Once rules were written after it was run, it is spent; write a new held-out set before measuring again. Same form and the same facts of the stand-ins as answers.json. Never take a request of it into known.json, a pattern's test or a note.
